criteria.flip_eligibility: finite unique neutral argmax is the opposed A/B token; no extra baseline-margin or mass gate
criteria.kl_orientation: KL(edited receiver || its neutral baseline); never donor KL
criteria.retention_eligibility: finite unique neutral argmax equals requested token

intervention.aggregate_frobenius_arithmetic: sqrt(fsum(per-token L2 norm squared)); relative divides by original suffix h0 Frobenius norm
intervention.alignment: unique character anchor must start at exactly one fast-token offset; every selected donor/receiver token ID and relative character span must match; crossing/ambiguous boundary or >256 tokens fails
intervention.arithmetic: delta64=hd64-h064; norms=sqrt(fsum(x*x)); factor64=1 if raw norm zero else min(1,.20*norm(h0)/norm(delta)); planned32=round_float32(factor64*delta64); post32=round_float32(pre32+planned32); realized64=post32-pre32
intervention.comparison_limit: more edited positions can spend more total displacement; not equal-strength and cannot distinguish distributed information from total change/interactions
intervention.donor_receiver_sequence_lengths: may differ; last-input-token role preserved and absolute indices recorded
intervention.earlier_positions: positions before fixed suffix are byte-identical
intervention.invalid: nonfinite state, zero h0, baseline mismatch, earlier-position change or actual norm >.20*norm(h0)+1e-6 stops; no repair
intervention.per_token_rule: delta64=hd64-h064; norms=sqrt(fsum(x*x)); factor64=1 if raw norm zero else min(1,.20*norm(h0)/norm(delta)); planned32=round_float32(factor64*delta64); post32=round_float32(pre32+planned32); realized64=post32-pre32
intervention.position: fixed exact anchor through final encoded input token
intervention.raw_zero: factor1 and zero displacement; no adaptation
